7179.title: Codex launch environment filtering: home fixed, launch overrides ignored
7179.rootCauseOneLine: The launch overlay includes CODEX_HOME but excludes thread executable and argument selectors; the home defect was repaired on November 3.
7179.proposedFix: Home forwarding already works. Decide the supported scope of executable selection before changing launch policy; preserve internal environment sanitization.
7179.caveats: Two clean runs use the trusted fake app-server; no live Codex login or rollout was exercised. Remaining launcher assertions are capability hypotheses, not an established supported contract.
